    FROM jan_returns

matches AS (

        t.casenum,

        rr.charge_pct,
        (

          + CASE WHEN rr.item_category IS NOT NULL AND rr.item_category <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

    FROM feb_returns b

          + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL AND r.pnl_kind <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AND r.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND r.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL AND r.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AND r.vol_tier <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM prepared s
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR r.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = 'ALL' OR r.warr_state = s.warrstate)

     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR r.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
),
best_rule AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM matched
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY snapkey
        ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC

    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw
      ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE p.start_date >= DATE '2023-12-01'
      AND p.start_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM dec_cases c
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = c.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = c.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = c.h1b_dependent)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = substr(c.soccd, 1, 2))
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = c.wsstate)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = c.monthly_volume_band)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY filekey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM matched_rules
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT
        c.homefirm,
        c.filekey,
        c.headct,
        COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50)
          + COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) * c.headct AS review_hours
    FROM dec_cases c
    LEFT JOIN ranked_rules r
      ON r.filekey = c.filekey
     AND r.rule_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    homefirm AS employer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(review_hours), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM case_hours
GROUP BY homefirm
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY SUM(review_hours) DESC, homefirm ASC
LIMIT 5;

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT c.*, try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') AS start_date
  FROM cases c
),
december AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM parsed
  WHERE start_date >= DATE '2023-12-01'
    AND start_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
volume AS (
  SELECT homefirm, COUNT(*) AS case_volume
  FROM december
  GROUP BY homefirm
),
case_inputs AS (
  SELECT
    d.filekey,
    d.homefirm,
    d.headct,
    CAST(d.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
    d.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
    substr(d.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
    CASE
      WHEN v.case_volume = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN v.case_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN v.case_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM december d
  JOIN volume v ON d.homefirm = v.homefirm
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = d.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
matched AS (
  SELECT
    ci.filekey,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    (
      CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS specificity
  FROM case_inputs ci
  JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = ci.visa_class)

WITH case_months AS (

        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
volumes AS (
    SELECT homefirm, start_month, count(*) AS monthly_volume
    FROM case_months
    GROUP BY homefirm, start_month
),
case_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        cm.*,
        CASE
            WHEN v.monthly_volume = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN v.monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN v.monthly_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM case_months cm
    JOIN volumes v USING (homefirm, start_month)
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        ca.filekey,
        ca.homefirm,
        ca.headct,
        ca.start_month,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        (
            CASE WHEN rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND rs.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND rs.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND rs.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND rs.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND rs.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND rs.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM case_attributes ca
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule rs
      ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = '*' OR rs.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
     AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = '*' OR rs.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
     AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = '*' OR rs.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
     AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = '*' OR rs.soc_major_group = substr(ca.soccd, 1, 2))
     AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = '*' OR rs.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
     AND (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR rs.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY filekey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM candidates
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        start_month,
        coalesce(base_hours, 3.50) + coalesce(position_hours, 0.50) * headct AS review_hours
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT

FROM case_hours

```sql
WITH dated_cases AS (
  SELECT c.*, try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS start_date
  FROM cases c
  WHERE try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_volume AS (
  SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date) AS start_month, count(*) AS case_count
  FROM dated_cases
  GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date)
),
target_cases AS (
  SELECT
    d.filekey,
    d.headct,
    d.visacls,
    d.h1bdep,
    d.soccd,
    cw.wsstate,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
    CASE
      WHEN mv.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS volume_band
  FROM dated_cases d
  JOIN monthly_volume mv
    ON mv.homefirm = d.homefirm
   AND mv.start_month = date_trunc('month', d.start_date)
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = d.filekey

WITH snapshot_context AS (
  SELECT
    pr.snapkey,
    pr.sitetie AS sitekey,
    pr.snapts,
    COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
    pm.makertag,
    pm.pnlkind,
    p.warrstate,
    CASE
      WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
      WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
      WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
    END AS cap_band,
    a.alrtstate,
    om.replcost,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.snapts),
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pr.snapts),
        COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted')
    ) AS monthly_volume
  FROM plant_record pr
  LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
  LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
      WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
      ELSE 'Bulk'
    END AS vol_tier
  FROM snapshot_context
),
ranked_matches AS (
  SELECT
    t.snapkey,
    r.rule_id,
    r.fixed_fee_usd,
    r.cover_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.snapkey
      ORDER BY
        (
          (r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AND r.maker_tag <> 'ALL')::INTEGER +
          (r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL AND r.pnl_kind <> 'ALL')::INTEGER +
          (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AND r.alrt_state <> 'ALL')::INTEGER +
          (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND r.warr_state <> 'ALL')::INTEGER +
          (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL AND r.cap_band <> 'ALL')::INTEGER +
          (r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AND r.vol_tier <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
        ) DESC,
        r.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM tiered t
  JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
    ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = t.makertag)
   AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
   AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR r.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)

   AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = 'ALL' OR r.cap_band = t.cap_band)
   AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR r.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
),
settlement AS (
  SELECT
    t.sitekey,
    CASE
      WHEN r.rule_id IS NULL
        THEN 300.00 + 0.05 * COALESCE(t.replcost, 0.0)
      ELSE r.fixed_fee_usd + (r.cover_pct / 100.0) * COALESCE(t.replcost, 0.0)
    END AS settlement_usd
  FROM tiered t
  LEFT JOIN ranked_matches r
    ON r.snapkey = t.snapkey
   AND r.rn = 1
  WHERE t.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
    AND t.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01'
)
SELECT
  sitekey,
  ROUND(SUM(settlement_usd), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM settlement
GROUP BY sitekey
ORDER BY settlement_usd DESC NULLS LAST, sitekey
LIMIT 5;

```sql
WITH parsed_cases AS (
    SELECT c.*,
           try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS start_date
    FROM cases c
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT homefirm,
           date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE AS start_month,
           COUNT(*) AS case_count
    FROM parsed_cases
    WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE
),
target_cases AS (
    SELECT p.filekey,
           p.headct,
           p.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
           p.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
           left(p.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
           cw.wsstate,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
           CASE
               WHEN mv.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
               WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
               WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
               WHEN mv.case_count >= 15 THEN '15+'
           END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM parsed_cases p
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = p.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    LEFT JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.homefirm = p.homefirm
     AND mv.start_month = date_trunc('month', p.start_date)::DATE
    WHERE p.start_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND p.start_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND left(p.soccd, 2) = '13'
),
matched AS (
    SELECT t.filekey,
           r.rule_id,
           r.base_hours,
           r.position_hours,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY t.filekey
               ORDER BY
                   (
                       CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                     + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                     + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                     + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                     + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                     + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   ) DESC,
                   r.rule_id ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM target_cases t
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = t.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = t.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = t.h1b_dependent)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = t.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = t.wsstate)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = t.monthly_volume_band)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT filekey, base_hours, position_hours
    FROM matched
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
           AVG(COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50)
             + COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) * t.headct),
           2
       ) AS avg_case_review_hours
FROM target_cases t
LEFT JOIN governing g ON g.filekey = t.filekey;

WITH case_values AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,
    c.homefirm,
    c.headct,
    CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
    CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS h1b_dependent,
    LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
  FROM cases c
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
with_volume AS (
  SELECT
    cv.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) AS emcv
  FROM case_values cv
),
case_volume_band AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN emcv = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      WHEN emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
    END AS volume_band
  FROM with_volume
),
matched AS (
  SELECT
    cvb.*,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS specificity
  FROM case_volume_band cvb
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = cvb.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = cvb.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
),
governing AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(position_hours, 0.50) * headct AS crh
  FROM matched
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY filekey
    ORDER BY specificity DESC NULLS LAST, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
  ) = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(crh), 2) AS average_case_review_hours
FROM governing
WHERE soc_major_group = '13'
  AND start_month >= DATE '2024-01-01'
